source:
version: "1"
kind: miner
id: 0
slug: nexus-eth-pinned-balance-reference
protocol: generic
name: NEXUS Ethereum Historical Balance Reference
description: >-
  Keyless public Ethereum mainnet historical native-balance reference.
  Supports only chain=ethereum and metric=balance at an explicit numeric block.
base_url: https://eth.blockscout.com
auth:
  type: none
endpoints:
  - path: /pinned-eth-balance
    external_path: /api/v2/addresses/{address}/coin-balance-history
    method: GET
    description: >-
      Return Ethereum native ETH balance at the specified historical block.
      URL path address is exactly 0x plus 40 hexadecimal digits.
      Query block_number is an integer height, never latest.
      The first history item is the most recent state change at or before
      the requested block, expressed in wei. No result means no reference.
      Reject non-ethereum chains and non-balance metrics.
    intents:
      - ONCHAIN_METRIC_VERIFY_GENERAL
    params:
      path:
        required:
          - name: address
            type: string
            intents: ["*"]
            description: EVM Ethereum address, 0x followed by 40 hex digits.
      query:
        required:
          - name: block_number
            type: integer
            intents: ["*"]
            description: Historical Ethereum block number.
      header:
        required:
          - name: X-NEXUS-Chain
            type: string
            intents: ["*"]
            description: The question's chain, only ethereum.
            accepted_fields:
              - value: ethereum
                intents: ["*"]
                description: Ethereum mainnet only.
          - name: X-NEXUS-Metric
            type: string
            intents: ["*"]
            description: The question's metric, only balance.
            accepted_fields:
              - value: balance
                intents: ["*"]
                description: Native ETH balance only.
intent_mapping:
  ONCHAIN_METRIC_VERIFY_GENERAL:
    endpoint: /pinned-eth-balance
    input:
      address: {from: address}
      block_number: {from: block}
      X-NEXUS-Chain: {from: chain}
      X-NEXUS-Metric: {from: metric}
    output:
      balance_gwei: {path: items.0.value, unit: wei}
semantics:
  supported_intents:
    - ONCHAIN_METRIC_VERIFY_GENERAL
